title: CO and Fine-structure Lines Reveal Low Metallicity in a Stellar-mass-rich Galaxy at z ∼ 1?
question: Is the CO-faint, star-forming FR-II galaxy 3C 368 (z=1.131) low-metallicity, and what is its molecular gas mass from CO(4-3), [CI] and dust?

data.sensitivity: 120 uJy/beam per 60 km/s channel (CO), 130 (CI), 13 uJy/beam continuum

what.value: SFR ~350 Msun/yr, FIR luminosity 2.0e12 Lsun, dust mass 1.4e8 Msun from SED modeling

evidence.quote: who used that value to derive an FIR luminosity of 2.0 $\times$ 10$^{12}$ $L_{\odot}$

what.value: Previous ALMA 230 GHz continuum, [OIII] 52um flux, CO(2-1) upper limit, PDR modeling, electron density 1000 cm-3

evidence.quote: using our previous observations of the [O iii] 52 $\ensuremath{\mu}m$ line (cite: Lamarche2017).

what.value: Radio continuum at 8.21 and 4.71 GHz; lobe spectral index ~-1.5

evidence.quote: together with radio continuum observations at 8.21 and 4.71 GHz (observed-frame) (cite: Best1998)

what.value: Optical line fluxes [OIII] 5007 6.8e-18, [OII] 3727 5.9e-18, Hdelta 2.8e-19 W m-2

evidence.quote: Adopting an [O iii] 5007 Å  line flux of 6.8 $\times$ 10$^{-18}$ W m$^{-2}$ (cite: Jackson1997)

recipe.method: Continuum-subtracted moment-0 maps; 2D Gaussian fits; checked by integrating aperture spectra

recipe.goal: Dust slope and radio SED decomposition
recipe.method: Rayleigh-Jeans index from 480.5 GHz and 205 um points; fit thermal+nonthermal radio SED with alpha_nth fixed at 0.7

recipe.goal: Metallicity from [OIII]52um and free-free; compare R23
recipe.method: Ionic abundance from line flux/free-free ratio; T4=1, ne/np=1.05, ne=1000 cm-3; R23 compared
PDR Toolbox fit including CO(4-3) and [CI]; PDR mass following Hailey-Dunsheath 2010

recipe.goal: Molecular gas mass by three methods
recipe.method: CO(4-3) with r43/21>1.3 and metallicity-scaled alpha_CO; [CI] luminosity; gas-to-dust ratio
assumptions: alpha_CO~18 from metallicity (Glover & Mac Low 2011); X_CI=3e-5; Q10=0.6; GDR=540 at 0.3 Zsun

recipe.method: M_dyn = v_rot^2 r/G with v_rot=(pi/2) v_obs, r=0.5 FWHM from Gaussian fit

evidence.quote: We obtain a CO(4-3) line flux of 1.08 $\pm$ 0.14 Jy km s$^{-1}$
a [C i] 609 $\ensuremath{\mu}m$ line flux of 0.85 $\pm$ 0.09 Jy km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: Continuum core flux density at 225.5 GHz

evidence.quote: of 3.7 $\pm$ 0.4, or equivalently a dust-emissivity $\beta$ value
we obtain an estimated [O/H] ratio of 1.2 $\times$ 10$^{-4}$, or $\sim$ 0.3 Z$_\odot$ (cite: Asplund2009), within about a factor of two uncertainty
we obtain an R$_{23}$ value of $\sim$ 12.
We calculate a PDR gas mass of $\sim$ 1.7 $\times$ 10$^{10}$ $M_{\odot}$
we obtain a molecular mass of 6.4 $\times$ 10$^{10}$ $M_{\odot}$ (see Table 2).
We obtain a dynamical mass of $\sim$ 1.5 $\times$ 10$^{11}$ $M_{\odot}$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and moment-map velocity ranges
CLEAN threshold, masks, image size and cell size
Free-free flux density at 230 GHz details and CO(4-3) line width fits
Exact PDR Toolbox fit procedure and input line fluxes
Rest frequencies adopted for the lines
score_reason: Key imaging settings stated, but much analysis depends on external numbers and unspecified fits.
rediscovery_reason: Archival ALMA project code given, fluxes and masses numeric, recipe fairly clear.
